C0191.title: Douyin Announcement: 34 Arrested in Coordinated Crackdown on Fake Engagement and Click Farming Operations
C0191.summary: On November 15, 2024, Douyin issued a public notice confirming its ongoing efforts to combat click farming and fake engagement operations. The platform assisted law enforcement in apprehending 34 suspects involved in artificially inflating follower counts, viewership, and other metrics for accounts and livestreams through illicit means.

references.title: Douyin Announcement! Cooperating with Police to Arrest 34 People, Cracking Down on 'Vulgar Black Industry Chain', Fake Followers and Views...
